title: Source Code
content: Source Code, directed by Duncan Jones, is a mind-bending sci-fi thriller that follows Captain Colter Stevens, who finds himself trapped in a government experiment that allows him to relive the final eight minutes of a man's life over and over again. The mission: to prevent a bombing on a Chicago commuter train. As Stevens begins to uncover the truth behind the mission, he faces moral dilemmas and questions about identity, time, and free will. The film cleverly blends action and psychological suspense while exploring the idea of second chances and the ability to change the past. With strong performances from Jake Gyllenhaal and a twisty narrative, Source Code is a thought-provoking ride.
